newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: LWR says BIL not looking to break it up.
newsitem.headline: LWR says BIL not looking to break it up.

text.p: LWR Industries on Friday rejected the suggestion that Brierley Investments Ltd was preparing to break up the company.
"It's just another example of pure speculation," Glenn Keen, LWR general manager of corporate services, told Reuters.

The Independent Business Weekly on Friday said BIL, which owns 65 percent of LWR, was preparing to break up the clothing and textile manufacturer and sell off its companies because that was the best way for BIL to exit the company profitably.
The Independent also said LWR division Canterbury International was likely to be sold overseas and that buyers had already been sought.
But Keen said LWR had been in contact with BIL, who had confirmed that the article was "totally wrong".
"The only situation in place is us seeking a joint venture partner for Canterbury and nothing has changed from that path since we first announced it in December," Keen said.
